transcript.content: Hello, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, my mom wanted me to come. Mostly it's just that I... I can't make myself do anything anymore. I just sit in my room all day, usually in the same clothes. I stopped doing the things I used to do, like knitting or journaling, or going out for walks. I just don't do them. And when my mom asks me what's wrong, I... I barely even have the energy to answer her.
How long have you been feeling this way—unable to do things and staying in your room?
It's been going on for a while. I think... this whole decline really started about two years and two months ago. That was right around the time I started a community-college program.
During this time, have you experienced anything unusual—like hearing voices or seeing things others don't, or having thoughts or beliefs that others found strange or hard to believe?

Well... my mom thinks my thoughts are strange. Since I was in those college classes, I've just known what they were doing. The school portal and the clinic practicum people... they were using these little wording changes in emails and assignment comments. It was a way to mark me as someone they don't want in healthcare. My mom says they're just regular messages when she looks at them, but... I know what they actually mean.

Thinking back over these two years, have there been times when you believed the school was sending you these coded messages even when your mood and energy were okay—not just during the periods when you felt down and unmotivated?

I'm not really sure. I... I don't think I've had times where my energy was okay. It feels like I've just been tired and stuck in my room this whole time. So I don't really know how to answer that... the messages were just happening, but I don't remember ever feeling good or having energy while it was going on.
Have you ever had a period—lasting several days or more—where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or needed much less sleep than usual, even if it was before this two-year period started?

No, I... I don't think so. I've never really felt like that. I've just been tired and down for a long time. I don't remember ever having a time where I felt super energetic or didn't need sleep. It's mostly just been the opposite.
Besides the low energy and staying in your room, have you noticed changes in your sleep or appetite, or feelings of guilt or worthlessness, during this time?

Um, not really. I mean... I sleep a lot since I'm just in my room all day, but it hasn't really changed. My appetite is just normal, I guess. I just eat whatever my mom makes for me. And... no, I don't think I feel guilty or anything like that. I just feel really drained all the time.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear, or seen things that others didn't see, during this time?

No, I... I haven't heard any voices or anything like that. And I haven't seen anything that isn't there. It's just... it's just the messages from the school. That's the only thing. But no voices or sounds.
Have you noticed any changes in the way you speak or think—like your thoughts feeling jumbled, or having trouble organizing your speech so others have difficulty following you?

No, not really. I mean... I don't talk to a lot of people right now anyway, mostly just my mom. But she understands me fine. I don't think my thoughts are jumbled or anything like that. I can still put my words together okay.
